qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global volume scale and extensive dealer networks fail to protect economic returns. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~4.2%, far below the 12% threshold, burdened by high German union labor costs, massive capex/R&D requirements, and fierce price competition from Chinese EV entrants.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Legacy automotive OEM burdened by structurally sub-hurdle capital efficiency (5-year median GAAP ROIC ~4.2%), high German union labor costs, software execution issues (CARIAD), and market share erosion in China against agile EV competitors.
qualitative.evidence: Automotive division ROI was 9.7% in 2024 and 10.4% in 2021, with group GAAP ROIC averaging ~3.5-4.2% over 5 years, well below the 12% hurdle. Massive capex and R&D requirements (~€20B+ annually) combined with aggressive EV price wars prevent economic profit generation.
